## Main concepts

| Term       | Meaning                                                              |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ROS        | The IOTC Regional Observer Scheme.                                   |
| Form       | An Excel workbook used to report observations.                       |
| Form model | A YAML definition of the form's expected structure and constraints.  |
| Consumer   | Software that uses a form model, such as an exporter or a validator. |

## Selecting a form model

| Term         | Meaning                                                    |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| Gear         | Longline (LL) or purse seine (PS).                         |
| Form version | The explicit version of a ROS form definition.             |
| Sheet        | A named worksheet described by the form model.             |
| Field        | One declared value, located in a cell or a table column.   |
| Layout       | The positions of fixed cells or the start of a data table. |

### Constraints and keys

| Term        | Meaning                                                            |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Constraint  | A requirement on a field or record.                                |
| Primary key | Fields whose combined values identify a record within a sheet.     |
| Parent key  | Fields linking a record to a record in another sheet.              |
| Unique key  | Fields whose combined values must be unique when all are supplied. |

### References

A reference binding identifies a catalogue, table and lookup used by a field.

The form model carries the binding; `ros.form.references` supplies lookup policies and reference data.
